title: Live Forecasts and Standby Intent
summary: WLU supports authenticated forecasts and standby claims to allow schedulers to provision rescue capacity before a fallback is triggered.
why: Avoids 'blind' fallback where a rescue path is chosen only to find it cannot be admitted due to capacity, while avoiding the waste of reserving a real reservation for every possible path.
invariants: Forecasts: Non-entitling observations of remaining budget (WITHIN_BUDGET, AT_RISK, EXPECTED_OVER_BUDGET).
Standby: Authenticated intent for a rescue stage; reserves 0 account/hierarchy WLU and 0 WLU/s.
Promotion: The explicit act of converting a standby intent into a hard reservation.
A failed promotion leaves the standby active so the scheduler can still react.
evidence_note: Source: oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12/README.md:185-215. Line 190: 'A standby is deliberately weaker than a reservation... reserves 0 account WLU'.
